description: Every pnpm allowBuilds entry must have an explicit, reviewable reason.

@anthropic-ai/claude-code.reason: Installs the managed Claude CLI used by the claude-cli reasoning backend.

@scarf/scarf.reason: Package telemetry is intentionally disabled for deterministic, governed installs.

esbuild.reason: Build tooling requires the platform esbuild binary.

node-pty.reason: Terminal and CLI actuator tests require the native pseudo-terminal binding.

onnxruntime-node.reason: Local inference actuators require the native ONNX runtime binding.

protobufjs.reason: The installed runtime is used by protocol and generated-message integrations.

puppeteer.reason: Browser actuator provisioning uses the package-managed browser runtime.

sharp.reason: Media and document actuators require the native image processing binary.

sqlite3.reason: Durable mission and history integrations require the native SQLite binding.

tesseract.js.reason: OCR capability provisioning requires its worker/runtime assets.

unrs-resolver.reason: The resolver supplies the platform-specific native module used by the build toolchain.
